why: Q.8 reads 'Some symbols are given below. Explain those symbols. Which disasters may occur if those symbols are ignored?' and the symbols are printed directly under it as a 3x3 grid of red-bordered diamond pictograms in the left column of printed p120. They carry NO text of any kind, so the stem names nothing and points at nothing without them and the row is unanswerable as text alone. The crop leaks no answer: the meanings are exactly what the question asks for, and the chapter prints the meaning of none of these nine anywhere (its own fig. 10.2 on p116 shows three DIFFERENT placards, which do carry labels). The bbox is bounded above by the last line of the Q8 stem and below by the Q9 heading, and x1 stops short of the page's right column so the 'Project:' text cannot bleed in - both edges verified on a 4x render.
verified: Rendered at 4x and eyeballed: all nine pictograms complete, none clipped, no text of any kind inside the crop.

why: Q.11 reads 'Following are the pictures of some disasters. How will be your pre- and post-disaster management in case you face any of those disasters?' The four pictures are printed in the RIGHT column of printed p120 while the stem sits in the left column; the stem names no disaster, so the row is unanswerable without them. The crop carries only the four pictures and their a./b./c./d. labels - no other text - so it leaks nothing: the question does not ask what the pictures show, it asks for the management. The bbox stops above the 'Project:' heading (which begins at about y=0.48) and x0 was moved right from 0.465 to 0.478 after a first render showed slivers of the left column's text bleeding in at the edge.
verified: Rendered at 4x and eyeballed: all four pictures complete with their labels, no 'Project:' text, no left-column bleed.
